meta.name: ExternalPowerSupply
meta.description: Vehicle external power supply module. Supports starting and stopping output, setting a reserve battery threshold, and querying actual output power, connection state, and protection reasons. Starting requires a connected external load and sufficient energy conditions. Output stops when the reserve threshold or a protection condition is reached.

output_active.description: Whether the module is currently supplying external power.

reserve_percent.description: Battery percentage reserved from external discharge. Output cannot operate when battery_percent is at or below this threshold.

output_power.description: Actual measured external output power. It equals load_power_demand while output is active and permitted, and is zero while output is stopped.

load_connected.description: Whether an external electrical load is currently connected.

battery_percent.description: Current vehicle battery percentage used to enforce the external-discharge reserve threshold.

load_power_demand.description: Power requested by the connected external load, bounded by this simulated module's 6000 W rating.

protection_reason.description: Current condition that blocks or stopped external output. Reserve protection is derived from battery_percent and reserve_percent; other conditions are supplied by deterministic feedback.

get_output_active.description: Return whether external power is currently being supplied.

output_active.description: Whether external power output is active.

get_reserve_percent.description: Return the configured external-discharge battery reserve threshold.

reserve_percent.description: Configured battery reserve threshold in percent.

set_reserve_percent.description: Set the reserve threshold to an integer from 0 through 100 percent. After assignment, if battery_percent is at or below the new threshold, active output stops, output_power becomes zero, and protection_reason becomes reserve_threshold_reached unless another reported protection reason is already active. If the battery is above the new threshold and the previous reason was reserve_threshold_reached, that reason is cleared to none; output does not restart automatically. Invalid input leaves all state unchanged.

errorcodes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: Reserve percentage must be an integer from 0 through 100.

get_output_power.description: Return actual measured external output power in watts. Stopped output always reports zero.

output_power.description: Actual external output power from 0 through 6000 W.

get_load_connected.description: Return whether an external electrical load is connected.

load_connected.description: Whether an external load is connected.

get_battery_percent.description: Return the battery percentage currently used for reserve-threshold protection.

get_load_power_demand.description: Return the power currently requested by the connected external load.

load_power_demand.description: Connected-load power demand from 0 through 6000 W.

get_protection_reason.description: Return the current energy or protection condition blocking external output. A value of none means no energy or protection restriction is active.

report_feedback.description: Apply one complete deterministic feedback sample. The supplied connection, battery percentage, and load demand replace their previous values. A supplied protection reason other than none takes priority; otherwise protection_reason becomes reserve_threshold_reached when battery_percent is at or below reserve_percent, or none when it is above the threshold. If output is active, it remains active with output_power equal to load_power_demand only when the load is connected and the resulting protection reason is none. Otherwise output stops and output_power becomes zero. Inactive output remains stopped with zero output power. Invalid input leaves all state unchanged.

load_connected.description: Whether the external load is connected.

semantics.reason: The feedback sample derives reserve protection and conditionally stops output or maps load demand to measured output; this conditional multi-property mapping is not expressible by the standard update semantics.

errorcodes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: Feedback values must satisfy their declared types and ranges.

start_output.description: Start external power output. The action succeeds only while output is stopped, a load is connected, and protection_reason is none. A none protection reason establishes that the latest battery feedback is above reserve_percent and no other reported protection condition is active. On success, output_active becomes true and output_power becomes the current load_power_demand. A rejected request leaves all state unchanged.

semantics.reason: Starting requires preconditions and copies the current load_power_demand property into output_power, which cannot be represented by literal or parameter update bindings.

errorcodes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: Output must be stopped, a load must be connected, and protection_reason must be none.

stop_output.description: Stop external power output from any state and set measured output power to zero. Reserve configuration and feedback states are preserved.
